fields.System.Title: FDN-606 — Discontinue a product
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a system administrator, I want to discontinue a product, so that we stop receiving
it while still selling down the stock we hold.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an active product, when I discontinue it, then new receipts of it are
  • rejected.
  • - Given a discontinued product with stock, then it can still be allocated, picked, and
  • shipped.
  • - Given a discontinued product, then it can still be counted.
  • - Given a product with an open ASN, when I discontinue it, then I am warned and the
  • ASN is listed.
  • - Given any product, then there is no endpoint that hard deletes it.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | masterdata |
| Tables | product |
| Risks | Hard delete orphans history ([doc 03 §5](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
